onboarding.title: Welcome to ADHDev
onboarding.intro: Pick the providers you want to use. Defaults to the four officially supported CLI providers; you can install IDE, ACP, or extension providers from the tabs below or later from Burrow → Providers → Add provider.

about.title: About
about.subtitle: Self-hosted ADHDev overview, built-in surfaces, and what changes in Cloud
about.headline: Keep the same dashboard experience, with the runtime fully on-device.
about.description: Standalone keeps the browser, daemon, screenshots, and control path on your own machine. It is the same core product shape as cloud, just without the remote networking and team layers.
about.includedDescription: The local-first feature set available without the cloud control plane.
about.inventoryDescription: Bundled editors and agent surfaces exposed in the standalone dashboard. These lists describe inventory, not verified support.
about.cloudExtrasDescription: Capabilities that need the hosted control plane or team infrastructure.
about.comparisonDescription: The product split at a glance.
about.cloudOptionalDescription: You can stay fully local in standalone, and move to cloud later without changing how you use the dashboard.
